title: A universal leading-residue formula for Witten zeta functions
summary: Let $Φ$ be an irreducible crystallographic root system of rank $r$, with Coxeter number $h$, Weyl group $W$, Cartan matrix $C_Φ$, and invariant degrees $2=d_1\leq\cdots\leq d_r=h$. We prove that Au's normalized Witten zeta function has a simple pole at $2/h$ and evaluate its residue as $\frac{2(2π)^{r/2}\sqrt{\det C_Φ}}{h|W|}\cdot\frac{\prod_{i<r}Γ(1-d_i/h)}{Γ(1-1/h)^r}$.
